_doc: Required elements of a methods/experiments chapter. An element is covered in the materials when a fact with one of `keys` exists (or a material line matches `material_patterns`), and covered in the draft when a sentence matches `draft_patterns` (en|zh) AND carries a fact/source tag, or the draft marks it as a gap ([[GAP:...]]). level: required = FAIL when neither covered nor marked; recommended = warn. profiles: which domain profiles need the element (all = every profile).

label.en: ordered procedure (input -> operation -> output per step)
label.zh: 有序步骤（每步输入→操作→输出）

question.en: Confirm the order of the processing stages and the output of each stage.
question.zh: 请确认各处理阶段的先后顺序及每一步的产出。

draft_patterns.zh: 数据集|语料|数据来源|样本来源|队列|问卷|调查|研究对象|受试者

question.en: Name the dataset and where it was obtained (URL/DOI/accession).
question.zh: 请给出数据集名称及获取来源（URL/DOI/编号）。

label.zh: 数据集版本/发布号/快照日期

draft_patterns.zh: 版本|发布|快照|下载于|获取于|修订|revision|调查(时间|于)|至

question.en: Which dataset version/release (or download date) was used? Different versions change sample counts and splits.
question.zh: 使用的是哪个数据集版本/发布号（或下载日期）？版本不同会改变样本数与划分。

label.en: split sizes/ratios and how they were drawn
label.zh: 划分规模/比例与划分方式

draft_patterns.zh: 划分|训练集|验证集|测试集|折交叉|留出

question.en: Give the train/validation/test sizes (or ratio), whether the split is random/stratified/official, and its seed.
question.zh: 请给出训练/验证/测试集规模（或比例）、划分方式（随机/分层/官方）及划分种子。

draft_patterns.zh: 预处理|归一化|分词|过滤|筛选|增强|清洗|剔除|排除

question.en: Describe preprocessing and filtering (what was removed and how many items).
question.zh: 请说明预处理与筛选（剔除了什么、剔除多少条）。

draft_patterns.zh: 购自|来源|试剂|细胞系|菌株|样本|抗体|试剂盒|批号

question.en: List materials/samples with supplier, catalogue and lot numbers.
question.zh: 请列出材料/样本及供应商、货号和批号。

label.en: simulated system and model (size, force field/functional)
label.zh: 模拟体系与模型（规模、力场/泛函）

draft_patterns.zh: 原子|分子|盒子|体系|力场|势函数|泛函|基组

question.en: Give system composition/size and the force field or functional with version.
question.zh: 请给出体系组成/规模及力场或泛函（含版本）。

draft_patterns.zh: 模型|结构|骨干|网络|初始化|预训练|检查点

question.en: Which model/architecture and which pretrained checkpoint (name + revision)?
question.zh: 使用了哪种模型/结构及哪个预训练检查点（名称+版本）？

label.en: optimiser, learning rate, batch size, training length
label.zh: 优化器、学习率、批大小、训练长度

draft_patterns.zh: 学习率|批大小|批量|优化器|轮|步|迭代

question.en: Confirm optimiser, learning rate (and schedule), batch size and number of epochs/steps of the reported run.
question.zh: 请确认报告结果所用运行的优化器、学习率（及调度）、批大小和训练轮数/步数。

draft_patterns.zh: ℃|°C|分钟|小时|毫|微|转|飞秒|皮秒|纳秒|压强|浓度

question.en: Give every operating condition (temperature, time, concentration, pressure, time step) with units.
question.zh: 请给出全部操作条件（温度、时间、浓度、压强、步长）及单位。

draft_patterns.zh: GPU|显卡|CPU|节点|集群|服务器|处理器

question.en: Which hardware (GPU/CPU model and count) produced the reported results?
question.zh: 报告结果使用的硬件（GPU/CPU 型号与数量）是什么？

draft_patterns.zh: 仪器|显微镜|光谱仪|分析仪|酶标仪|离心机|PCR仪|型号

question.en: Give manufacturer and model for each instrument and its settings.
question.zh: 请给出各仪器的厂家、型号及设置。

draft_patterns.zh: (?i)版本|软件|程序包|\b(pytorch\-lightning|quantum\-espresso|opencv\-python|sentencepiece|scikit\-learn|transformers|torchvision|statsmodels|torchaudio|accelerate|tensorflow|matplotlib|tokenizers|hydra\-core|deepspeed|lightning|biopython|omegaconf|datasets|lightgbm|catboost|graphpad|gaussian|samtools|cellpose|pytorch|sklearn|xgboost|seaborn|gromacs|openmpi|python|pandas|pillow|lammps|openmm|deseq2|seurat|scanpy|imagej|matlab|docker|torch|cudnn|numpy|scipy|keras|stata|prism|amber|rdkit|edger|julia|mpich|slurm|conda|wandb|cuda|nccl|peft|flax|timm|lme4|spss|vasp|orca|cp2k|namd|gatk|star|fiji|vllm|jax|bwa|gcc)\b|\b(gen5|drc|mice|R\s+\d+\.\d+|v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\b

question.en: List software with exact versions (framework, CUDA, analysis packages).
question.zh: 请列出软件及精确版本（框架、CUDA、分析软件包）。

draft_patterns.zh: 种子

question.en: Which random seed(s) were used for training, data splitting and sampling?
question.zh: 训练、数据划分与采样分别使用了哪些随机种子？

label.en: number of repetitions / replicates and how results are aggregated
label.zh: 重复次数/平行样数及结果汇总方式

draft_patterns.zh: 重复|平行|独立|次运行|均值|平均

question.en: How many independent runs/replicates per condition, and is mean ± SD/SE or a single run reported?
question.zh: 每个条件独立运行/平行样多少次？报告的是均值±标准差/标准误还是单次结果？

label.en: baselines with versions and same-budget conditions
label.zh: 基线（含版本）及同预算对照条件

draft_patterns.zh: 基线|对照|比较|对比

question.en: Which baselines (implementation + version) were compared, and were they trained/tuned under the same budget and data?
question.zh: 对比了哪些基线（实现+版本）？是否在相同数据与预算下训练/调参？

label.zh: 对照组（阳性/阴性/溶剂对照）

draft_patterns.zh: 对照|空白|溶剂|安慰剂|假手术|未处理

question.en: Which control groups were run alongside each condition?
question.zh: 每个条件同时设置了哪些对照组？

draft_patterns.zh: 指标|准确率|精度|F1|误差|召回|测量|结局|得分|产率|效率|吸光度|存活率|密度|强度|能量|扩散

question.en: Define each metric (and on which split / at which checkpoint it is computed).
question.zh: 请定义各评价指标（在哪个数据子集、哪个检查点上计算）。

label.zh: 统计检验/不确定度估计

draft_patterns.zh: 检验|方差分析|置信区间|标准差|标准误|显著

question.en: Which statistical test or uncertainty estimate supports comparisons (test, alpha, correction)?
question.zh: 比较结论基于何种统计检验或不确定度估计（检验方法、显著性水平、多重校正）？

draft_patterns.zh: 提交|仓库|代码|命令|脚本|镜像|环境

question.en: Give the code commit/tag and the exact commands to reproduce the reported numbers.
question.zh: 请给出代码提交号/标签及复现报告数值的确切命令。

draft_patterns.zh: 获取|下载|公开|链接|DOI|许可|申请

question.en: How can readers obtain the data (URL/DOI, license, access restrictions)?
question.zh: 读者如何获取数据（URL/DOI、许可、访问限制）？

label.en: limitations tied to concrete failure scenarios
label.zh: 落到具体失效场景的限制条件

draft_patterns.zh: 局限|限制|不足|仅在|仅适用|未(在|对|覆盖|测试|评估)|失效|无法

question.en: Which conditions were not tested (data, scale, hardware, settings) and where is the method expected to fail?
question.zh: 哪些条件未测试（数据、规模、硬件、设置）？方法在哪些具体场景下可能失效？

zh: 有待进一步(研究|验证|探索)
